scope: Lite product usability, reliability and dark-theme accessibility; not public deployment acceptance
changes: Class-aware generation with numeric class order, explicit sheet-label detection and topic/objective search
Class filter precedes curriculum rows; filtering preserves the whole plan
Obsolete collection/resource reads are aborted or ignored after navigation or newer edits
Successful saves immediately update the known revision for both curriculum and task editing
Discard task changes correctly supports cancel and confirm without corrupting the saved task snapshot
Readable dark navigation, success/error messages, source text, logo and keyboard skip link
Curriculum status filter uses review rather than the generation-specific needs_review
reproducedBeforeFix: A delayed opened curriculum replaced the upload screen after navigation
Axe reported source-text contrast around 1.06:1 in the dark theme

verification.finalKeyboardFocusContrastScenario: passed in Chromium and WebKit after the final skip-link CSS adjustment
verification.actualLegacyBrowser: Firefox ESR 115.40.0 win32; isolated profile on the current Windows host
verification.legacyWorkflow: login without verification, DOCX import/confirmation, class/topic search, task editing, teacher approval and DOCX export

limits: A physical Windows 7 PC, its TLS stack and hardware speed were not tested
The generation request contract test intercepts the provider operation; it does not evaluate AI pedagogy
Unsaved-curriculum generation transitions, multi-tab conflict UX, account password management and the wider product audit remain active work
Public deployment remains deferred until payment
